blocks.text: It’s heat maxxing before the end of the year as K-pop rapper and singer-songwriter Lee Minhyuk, also known by his solo stage name HUTA, makes his comeback to the Philippines for the 2026 LEE MINHYUK (HUTA) CONCERT <HEAT MAX> in MANILA on November 21, 2026 (Saturday). The event will take place at the SM North EDSA Skydome and is scheduled to start at 7:00 PM (PHT). Popularly known as the King of Waterbomb, Minhyuk promises his Pinoy fans a blazing and high energy weekend for all the concert-goers this year.
